easy.q: How many countries share a land border with Portugal?
easy.fact: Spain wraps around Portugal on the north and east; the Atlantic does the rest.

easy.q: How many strings does a standard ukulele have?
easy.fact: The ukulele grew out of small guitars brought to Hawaii by Portuguese immigrants in the 1870s.

easy.q: In baseball, how many balls does it take to draw a walk?
easy.fact: It took as many as nine balls for a walk in the 1880s.

easy.q: How many guns are fired in the salute traditionally given to a head of state?
easy.fact: Firing a salute once meant emptying your weapons to show you meant no harm.

easy.q: How many Bridgerton siblings are there in the Netflix series?
easy.fact: Their first names run in alphabetical order, from Anthony to Hyacinth.

medium.q: How many Emmys did FX's Shōgun win for its first season in 2024, a record for a single season?
medium.fact: It beat the old record of 13, set by HBO's John Adams miniseries in 2008.

medium.q: How many men sailed with Ernest Shackleton on the Endurance, all of whom survived after it sank in Antarctic ice?
medium.fact: The wreck was found in 2022, nearly 10,000 feet down in the Weddell Sea.

medium.q: The equator passes through how many countries, counting their waters?
medium.fact: Ecuador is named for it: ecuador is Spanish for equator.

medium.q: In curling, how many stones does each team throw in one end?
medium.fact: Most curling stones are made from granite quarried on a single Scottish island, Ailsa Craig.

medium.q: When the College Football Playoff expanded in 2024, how many teams made the field?
medium.fact: Ohio State won the first 12-team playoff, beating Notre Dame in the title game.

hard.q: How many rooms does the White House have?
hard.fact: It also has 35 bathrooms, 28 fireplaces and 8 staircases.

hard.q: North Carolina's Mount Mitchell is the highest peak east of the Mississippi River. How tall is it, in feet?
hard.fact: It's named for Elisha Mitchell, a professor who measured it in the 1830s.

hard.q: To the nearest pound, how much does the standard men's Olympic weightlifting bar weigh?
hard.fact: The women's bar is lighter and a bit thinner, at about 33 pounds.

hard.q: The Xbox Series X launched in November 2020 at what price, in dollars?
hard.fact: It came out the same week as the PlayStation 5, which also started at $499.
